leadText: The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the twenty-third season of , Pokémon Journeys: The Series, in and ( ).
plainText:
The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the twenty-third season of , Pokémon Journeys: The Series, in and ( ).

==Partial collections==
Two Pokémon Journeys: The Series Collections were released by Shock Entertainment in 2021, containing the whole season between them.

===Pokémon Journeys: The Series - Collection 1===
 
Pokémon Journeys: The Series - Collection 1 was released by Shock Entertainment in Australia on March 3, 2021 and in New Zealand on May 19, 2021. It contains three discs with 24 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is KAL5564B.

====Contents====
Each disc features artwork of a specific Pokémon on the disc itself. 
 

===Pokémon Journeys: The Series - Collection 2===
 
Pokémon Journeys: The Series - Collection 2 was released by Shock Entertainment in Australia on June 2, 2021 and in New Zealand on July 21, 2021. It contains three discs with 24 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is KAL5624B.

====Contents====
Each disc features artwork of a specific Pokémon on the disc itself. 
 

==Complete Season disc set==
 
The Pokémon Journeys - Complete Series was released by Shock Entertainment in Australia on June 2, 2021 and in New Zealand on July 21, 2021. It contains six discs with 48 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is KAL5632B.

===Contents===
Each disc features artwork of a specific Pokémon on the disc itself.
